brief: Two separate pairs of bases, the pairs joined to each other only with side connectors.

requirements.evidence: 4 bases placed: pair A 0,0+1,0 and pair B 0,1+1,1. Each pair is a neighboring adjacency.

requirements.requirement: The pairs joined to each other only with side connectors (no joint bolts or other joinery)
requirements.evidence: 4 side connectors only: connector:0#0,0|1,0 (double) and connector:0#0,1|1,1 (double) intra-pair, plus connector:0#0,0|0,1 (single) and connector:0#1,0|1,1 (single) inter-pair. No jointBolt nodes present; find_sockets shows jointBolts available but not used.

finish.summary: 4 bases in 2x2 parallelogram forming two horizontal pairs (y=0 and y=1). Intra-pair joints double side-connectors, inter-pair joints single side-connectors. All connections are side connectors, no joint bolts, satisfying 'pairs joined to each other only with side connectors'. check_build ok true, meshClash clear.

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
